List of reportedly haunted locations in the United Kingdom
The following is a list of reportedly haunted locations in the
United Kingdom
.
Great Britain is reputedly the most haunted landmass in the world, with
England
being the most haunted country, reporting the densest coverage of purported ghost sightings and paranormal experiences both per person and by geographical area.

Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland are also rich in ghost lore, albeit less densely populated, and there is not a single village, town, or city without reports of ghosts and a belief in ghosts dating back multiple centuries.
